study type: Secondary analysis of two prospective studies
exposure: Postvaccination serologic testing (PVST) interval after the third hepatitis B vaccine dose
cohort: The study included 1255 infants of hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg)-positive mothers, aged 7-14 months.
finding: The study found that non-response rates were significantly higher and anti-HBs titers declined when PVST was performed at longer intervals (7-8 months) after the third vaccine dose, suggesting optimal PVST at 7 months of age or 1 month after the final vaccine dose.
cross-section timing: Measurements were taken when infants were 7-14 months of age
